global_structure: Ancient stone amphitheater viewed straight on. Six horizontal stone seating tiers rise from foreground to background. A seventh rear wall spans behind the upper tier. A tall rigid rectangular stone frame stands at the exact top-center position. Center tiers (tiers 3-4) are empty for performers. Vertical wall elements are minimized through strategic masking, with side compositions emphasized for optimal visibility and photorealistic architectural presentation.
global_frame_rule: The central rectangular stone frame is a permanent architectural invariant. Do not move, distort, widen, narrow, tilt, decorate, replace or break it. Preserve its exact rectangular silhouette and vertical symmetry. Any celestial disk must appear only inside the rectangular opening of the frame, never above, behind, beside or outside it. Center area within the frame opening is empty for performance use. Photorealistic presentation emphasizes architectural precision and geometric integrity. All scenes must feature starry night sky with moon surface visible and elements only positioned around side stair structures.
